about.meta_description: Inter Trans MMS — A trusted partner with over 30 years of experience in international transportation, customs and logistics.
about.page_subtitle: At every step of international trade, by your side with over 30 years of experience.
about.story_p1: Inter Trans MMS (Multi Modal Services) is an end-to-end solution partner in international and domestic transportation, customs brokerage and logistics. By bringing air, sea and road freight under one roof, we deliver your cargo safely to its destination.
about.story_p2: With our strong international partner network, experienced team and technology-driven process management, we ensure transparency and traceability in every shipment. From complex project cargo to daily LCL shipments — we are with you at every scale.
about.values_section_subtitle: The core principles that shape how we work.

values.mission_text: To manage our customers' supply chains in the most efficient, transparent and reliable way, providing competitive advantage in global trade.
values.vision_text: To become the region's reference logistics brand, combining technology and human expertise in multimodal transportation.
values.values_text: Trust, transparency, on-time delivery and customer focus form the foundation of all our operations.

about.why_section_subtitle: The key advantages trusted by companies that choose us.

services.meta_description: Air cargo, sea and road transportation, customs brokerage, logistics & warehousing and project cargo — Inter Trans MMS services.
services.page_subtitle: End-to-end integrated solutions in transportation, customs and logistics.
services.section_subtitle: Together we determine the most suitable transport mode and operational plan for your needs.

hava-kargo.title: Air Cargo
hava-kargo.excerpt: Fast and secure air cargo solutions to all destinations. Express options.
hava-kargo.description: For your time-sensitive shipments, we provide fast, secure and traceable air cargo service through our worldwide airline network. We plan the most suitable solution with standard, express and consolidated options.

highlights.title: Speed
highlights.text: Same/next day solutions for urgent shipments.

deniz-tasimaciligi.title: Sea Freight
deniz-tasimaciligi.excerpt: Full container (FCL), less-than-container (LCL) and special project transport.
deniz-tasimaciligi.description: We offer competitive freight rates and reliable line connections for your FCL, LCL and special project cargo. With end-to-end port-to-port operation management, your cargo is secure.

highlights.title: FCL & LCL
highlights.text: Flexible container solutions for every volume.

kara-yolu.title: Road Transport
kara-yolu.excerpt: Domestic and international. Express, LTL and temperature-controlled.
kara-yolu.description: Full truckload (FTL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) solutions for domestic and international road transport. With temperature-controlled, ADR-certified and standard transportation, we provide seamless access to Europe and neighboring countries.

highlights.title: Europe line
highlights.text: Fast transit via regular service network.

lojistik-depolama.title: Logistics & Warehousing
lojistik-depolama.excerpt: Secure storage, order fulfillment, cross-docking and bonded warehousing.
lojistik-depolama.description: With our modern warehouse infrastructure, we offer short- and long-term storage, inventory management, order fulfillment (pick & pack), cross-docking and bonded warehouse services. Manage your supply chain from a single point.

highlights.title: Flexible space
highlights.text: Storage that scales to your needs.

gumruk.title: Customs Import – Export
gumruk.excerpt: Manage your operations safely with our licensed customs brokerage.
gumruk.description: With our licensed customs brokers, we handle your import, export and transit operations in full compliance with regulations. We accelerate your processes with declaration preparation, customs regimes and consultancy.

highlights.title: Compliance
highlights.text: Operations in full compliance with current regulations.

highlights.title: Speed
highlights.text: Quick solutions for declaration and approval processes.

proje-tasimaciligi.title: Project Cargo
proje-tasimaciligi.excerpt: Heavy cargo, out-of-gauge and special project transport solutions.
proje-tasimaciligi.description: Engineering-based transport solutions for your heavy, out-of-gauge and special project cargo. We plan the most complex projects end-to-end with route surveys, permits, special equipment and insurance management.
